The above words best describe the feelings expressed at our Divisional 
Chairmen's meeting held on Wednesday, March 13th. 
while we only reported 58% which is $197,000 on our $340,000 objective, 
Civisional chairmen collectively reportec that all areas were hard at 

work anc that a final figure of $351,000 was possible, 
Commitment was expressed by everyone saying they were prepared to remain 
hard at work until the job was completed.
